meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 把解析好的文档和你的查询意图，转成四张卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡；黄卡经监察院复核、红卡经丞相府补全，每张卡片带来源与生成方式，可溯源。
howto.when: 当你有已解析的结构化文档并给出查询意图、需要做事实-解释-风险-行动分析时接管；也可直接运行脚本，按 extract、review、propose 三个阶段调用。

say.text: 把这份文档生成四色卡片
运行 extract 阶段，先抽事实蓝卡
对黄卡做过度声明复核
say.note: 黄卡经复核或标记 pending_review

howto.what_en: Turns a parsed document plus your intent into four cards: blue facts, green explanation, yellow risks, red actions. Each card carries its sources and generation method, so it stays traceable.
howto.when_en: Use it when you have a parsed structured document and a query intent for fact-explanation-risk-action analysis, or run the script with the stages extract, review, propose.

say_en.text: Generate four-color cards from this document
Run the extract stage to pull the fact card first
Review the yellow card for overclaims
say_en.note: Yellow card is reviewed or marked pending_review
